summary: Researched wiring verify-deploy.sh into deploy-headless.sh. Mechanically small change (insert call in the shared trailing block inside main(), after DEPLOY_COUNT check), but it collides with skill-orchestrate's existing pre/post baseline redeploy checkpoint (SKILL.md Stage MT-3 step 7, out of file_scope): a naive hard-fail-on-any-finding contract would destroy that checkpoint's pre-existing-failure tolerance (branch c). Recommend a distinct new exit code (not 2) plus documenting the interaction in regeneration-is-manual-only.md, and a --skip-slow verify-deploy.sh flag since the shell test suite measured 117.9s of the ~2.8min gate total. verify-deploy.sh gate 8 is currently red (3 pre-existing, unrelated test failures) in this repo.
